P-01.summary: Built V1.2 A/B/C/D/E comparison. Added Arm D (strongest published baseline: US20210338992A1 closed-loop shunt + 2023 ML study, reproduced as 4-segment predictive closed-loop modulation WITHOUT isolation) and Arm E (oracle: perfect knowledge, isolate at lesion onset). Ran 3 attack modes: none, misspecification (2x faster occlusion), sensor-noise (3x noise). KEY FINDING: C (predictive isolation) does NOT outperform D (predictive closed-loop) on time-to-failure. Under normal conditions: D wins 8.9h vs 7.7h (14% longer). Under sensor noise: D wins 8.9h vs 3.5h (61% longer). C only wins on peak ICP under low-noise conditions (22 vs 30 mmHg). Under noise, they're equal (~29 mmHg). The isolation mechanism is FRAGILE under realistic sensor noise because the trend predictor fires false positives, causing premature isolation. P-01's original value proposition is NOT supported.
